extendInfo.NSAppDataUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads is trying to read files that belong to another app, such as its settings or saved data. bb itself never needs this. Allow it only if you asked an agent to work with that app; otherwise choose Don't Allow and the command skips those files.
extendInfo.NSAppBundlesUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads is trying to change or delete another application. Allow it only if you asked an agent to install, update or remove that app.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads, or a file you picked in bb, is trying to use files in your Desktop folder. Allow it if you asked a thread to work with files there.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads, or a file you picked in bb, is trying to use files in your Documents folder. Allow it if you asked a thread to work with files there.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads, or a file you picked in bb, is trying to use files in your Downloads folder. Allow it if you asked a thread to work with files there.
extendInfo.NSNetworkVolumesUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads is trying to use files on a network drive. Allow it if you asked a thread to work with files there.
extendInfo.NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription: A command run by an agent in one of your bb threads is trying to use files on an external or removable drive. Allow it if you asked a thread to work with files there.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: bb uses the microphone when you dictate a message into the composer, or when a thread or plugin you started records audio.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: A thread or plugin you started in bb is trying to record the sound other apps are playing.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: A web page, plugin or agent command in bb is trying to use a Bluetooth device.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: A web page, plugin or agent command in bb is trying to use a Bluetooth device.
